title: Figma library: consolidate variants, auto-layout pruning, and publish runbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Scope: Clean up the Figma component library focusing on component variants (buttons, tables, chart legends), auto-layout issues, token naming mismatches, and produce an explicit publish runbook so downstream teams can safely update. Goal is a single source of truth for tokens and component APIs that reduces downstream dev friction and visual regressions.
tasks: Inventory current variants for buttons, inputs, table rows, and chart controls and map to desired variant properties (intent, size, density, state)
Merge duplicate variants: consolidate ghost/tertiary/secondary into single 'intent' property with values [primary, secondary, neutral, destructive]
Auto-layout cleanup: fix nested frames with mixed vertical/horizontal constraints, normalize padding to 8px scale, ensure hugging/pinning set appropriately for responsive tables and toolbar items
Token rename pass: replace legacy token names (primary-bg, text-weak, accent-2) with canonical tokens (color-brand-500, text-muted, color-accent-200). Produce mapping table in the Confluence doc
Chart components: standardize legend spacing and responsive breakpoint behavior; create compact/regular variants and document axis label token usage
Tables: add column-variant props (row-density: comfortable/compact), fix header auto-layout so sort icons don't push content, and ensure selection checkbox alignment across breakpoints
Create migration notes and changelog for the library publish including a list of potentially breaking token renames and recommended dev-side aliases
Run internal QA pass using smoke prompts: 20 sample pages and 5 app screens to catch regressions
Publish library: follow runbook steps, tag version, and send update to #design-system and product engineering release channel
acceptance_criteria: All button families exist as a single component with a documented 'intent' variant and sizes S/M/L; visual diffs within 2px for production screens
No components use legacy token names in the library file; token map documented and linked
Auto-layout issues causing overflow or misalignment are resolved on canonical demo frames for table and toolbar patterns
Publish runbook created with rollback steps and verified by one PM and one Eng reviewer
Library version published and consumed by two downstream repos without visual regressions reported within 48 hours
